cases.purpose: Candidate pty spawn creates and owns the client and its master; vt consumes actual client PTY bytes and forwards input, with independently observed client state and cleanup.
cases.oracle: Independent sealed python3-pyte0.8.0 (official source read as data), with literal grid/SGR/DA/DSR setup controls; native owned Python PTY echo/geometry/modes controls. VT profile uses VT102 primary DA, common pyte cell attributes and a declared xterm16 default white/black palette. PNG RGB8 filter0 CRC/zlib decode and fixed dimension expectations plus independent area-average half-block color math provide the tiv contract; no GNU tiv equivalence is asserted. No reference output is seeded from candidate data. Candidate uses actual pty spawn and its remembered child/master, while the native Python PTY reference is a separate control; exact client bytes and pyte model are fixed independently.
cases.comparison: result.json preserves complete per-cell text/attributes/cursor/reply bytes or exact truecolor image bytes. Every model command status, directional PTY/client I/O, termios, geometry, time, shell commands, child writes/reads and independent controls remain in HOME diagnostics. Reference and candidate use separate owned children. Candidate FAIL remains FAIL; future VM raw review must distinguish unreached phases. No GPU/physical terminal or exhaustive xterm claim. Owned broker ancestry, child identity, master descriptor, fixed output/input bytes, client termios, builtin waitpid status, close and shell exit are captured.
